author: Daniel Avalos
title: La justicia solo muerde los pies de los descalzos
content:
Un pedazo de carne, 36 días presa y una pregunta sobre la Justicia.

 Fotos y texto Daniel Ávalos para Anred.


Estela Chávez: 36 días detenida por un pedazo de carne, tiene más de 65 años, cobra la jubilación mínima y estuvo 36 días privada de su libertad por un presunto intento de hurto en un supermercado. Su familia reunió los $150.000 de caución para que recuperara la libertad. La causa sigue abierta. Su historia excede un episodio policial y abre una discusión sobre la Justicia, la pobreza y el papel del Estado en un contexto donde la respuesta represiva gana terreno. Estela trabajó durante años limpiando casas. Como tantas mujeres, pasó buena parte de su vida ocupándose de los hogares de otros. Tuvo seis hijos y, cuando ya no pudo seguir trabajando, accedió a la jubilación a través de una moratoria previsional. Hoy cobra el haber mínimo y vive en un barrio popular de San Fernando junto a una de sus nietas.El 8 de octubre fue detenida en un supermercado.


La acusación: intentar llevarse un corte de carne sin pagar. La interceptaron antes de cruzar la línea de cajas. Ese episodio terminó con Estela en una alcaidía, donde permaneció durante 36 días.El 26 de octubre se dictó su prisión preventiva. Fue alojada en la Alcaidía N.º 15, en Chacarita. Compartió una celda con otras cinco mujeres, tuvo una intoxicación con la comida y debió ser trasladada a un hospital. La familia podía acercarle ropa y elementos de higiene, pero no tenía permitido visitarla.Recién el 13 de noviembre recuperó la libertad. Para conseguirlo, sus familiares tuvieron que reunir los $150.000 fijados como caución. La causa por tentativa de hurto continúa abierta.Hay algo difícil de pasar por alto: una mujer que trabajó durante décadas, que cobra una jubilación mínima y que vive con ingresos insuficientes terminó privada de su libertad por un hecho vinculado con alimentos. ¿Era necesario mantenerla detenida durante 36 días? ¿Qué riesgos procesales justificaban esa decisión? ¿Qué otras alternativas podían haberse considerado?La prisión preventiva no es una condena. Es una medida excepcional que debe tener fundamentos concretos. En el caso de Estela no contamos con la resolución judicial completa ni conocemos en detalle los argumentos que llevaron a dictarla y sostenerla durante más de un mes. Pero esa falta de información tampoco clausura las preguntas sobre la proporcionalidad de la medida y sobre el trato que reciben las personas en situaciones de vulnerabilidad. Cuando la Justicia también forma parte del problema,la actuación judicial no puede analizarse como si ocurriera al margen de la sociedad en la que interviene. Tampoco alcanza con pensarla como una institución que simplemente aplica leyes. Sus decisiones tienen consecuencias concretas: determinan quién queda detenido, quién recupera la libertad y quién tiene que esperar detrás de una reja mientras se investiga una acusación.En la provincia de Buenos Aires, la Comisión Provincial por la Memoria viene advirtiendo sobre el funcionamiento de una cadena punitiva que articula a las fuerzas de seguridad, la Justicia penal y el sistema penitenciario. En su informe anual de 2026 señala que las prácticas policiales violentas encuentran con frecuencia una respuesta judicial que las convalida, en lugar de controlarlas.


Los números también hablan. Durante 2025 se dictaron 20.995 prisiones preventivas en la provincia, el 47% de las privaciones de libertad ordenadas ese año. Según el mismo informe, las personas detenidas pasaron, en promedio, 412 días privadas de su libertad hasta la sentencia de primera instancia. Todavía eran legalmente inocentes durante ese período.No son datos menores. Muestran hasta qué punto el encierro previo a una condena se ha extendido dentro del sistema penal. En estos tiempos, además, la discusión sobre la Justicia no puede separarse del avance de las políticas represivas. Mientras se endurece el discurso sobre la seguridad, se estigmatiza la protesta social y se multiplican las intervenciones de las fuerzas de seguridad frente a quienes reclaman, también crece la preocupación por el papel de las instituciones que deberían controlar esos procedimientos. La Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos expresó su preocupación por las restricciones al derecho a la protesta en Argentina, la violencia estatal en las movilizaciones y el uso de mecanismos judiciales que pueden limitar el debate público.¿Dónde queda la independencia judicial cuando las garantías parecen perder …

author: Jacob Andrewartha
title: Hundreds rally for AI data centre moratorium in Victoria
content:
More than 200 people joined a rally in Naarm/Melbourne, on November 14, calling for a statewide moratorium on the construction and rapid expansion of artificial intelligence data centres.

The rally was supported by several anti-AI data centre campaign groups, including from Clyde North, Campbellfield, South Morang, Plumpton and Melton People Power.

At least 60 sites across Victoria are being proposed for the construction of data centres.

The protest demanded that the government halt the construction of AI data centres until safeguards for communities, cultural heritage and the environment are written into law.

Gunditjmara, Djab Wurrung, Yuin and Bidjara woman Yaraan Couzens-Bundle told the rally that opposing AI data centres is linked to defending First Nations sovereignty over land and water systems.

She said investment in AI is linked to the expansion of militarism, and further ties Australia to the United States military industrial complex.

Samin Moslih, from No Data Centre in Campbellfield, said the rapid expansion of mega AI data centres is driven by corporate greed, and that not every technological advance imposed on us is necessarily progress.

Samantha, from the Plumpton Action Group, spoke about the environmental and community impacts of the proposed Plumpton data centre, which is proposed to be more than 350 hectares.

Protesters marched from the State Library Victoria to Parliament House, chanting “We need money for health and education, not AI corporations”.

Friends of the Earth campaigner Pat Simons ended the rally by comparing the growing campaign against AI Data Centres to the successful mass campaign against coal seam gas in Victoria. “We can win if we continue to fight.”

author: CMI Argentina
title: Mendoza: docentes se reunieron para tratar los problemas de la educación rural
content:
En Mendoza se conformó un espacio de encuentro entre educadores y educadoras huarpes de distintas comunidades rurales. La propuesta busca compartir experiencias, poner en debate las prácticas escolares y fortalecer el reconocimiento de la identidad y los saberes del pueblo Huarpe en las escuelas.


Escuchar el reporte de Radio Tierra Campesina de Mendoza


En el primer encuentro realizado en la comunidad del Cavadito participaron alrededor de ocho docentes que se desempeñan en distintas localidades del secano, entre ellas El Cavadito, San Miguel, El Forzudo, San José y Lagunas del Rosario. La mayoría trabaja en el nivel primario, aunque también hay educadores del secundario.


La propuesta comenzó a tomar forma a partir del vínculo entre docentes del territorio y un equipo de extensión universitaria integrado por Carla Rosales y Mercedes Molina.


En diálogo con Radio Tierra Campesina, Molina explicó: “La idea es pensar a la educación como un derecho, entonces la posibilidad de terminar la escuela secundaria tiene que ser una posibilidad real para los chicos y chicas que están ahí”.


También se abordan las dificultades que atraviesa la educación rural y la importancia de que las políticas educativas tengan en cuenta las particularidades de cada territorio. “Plantear lo que significa la identidad huarpe para los docentes, para el equipo de directivos, estas tensiones frente a las identidades y al reconocimiento, si está validado o no, qué implicancias tiene esto con las decisiones dentro de la escuela”, relató Carla Rosales.


Los educadores buscan fortalecer sus vínculos y seguir construyendo herramientas colectivas para defender una educación pública que reconozca los saberes y la identidad de los pueblos.


“La educación rural en este contexto se lleva la peor parte, para la economía dos más dos son cuatro y si hay poca gente sacas esa cuenta y parece que en la ruralidad eso no cierra”, concluyó Rosales.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: El negocio de la miseria: cinco billones en lujo, pólvora y fe
content:
Cada año, mientras cientos de millones de personas en el planeta carecen de agua potable, atención médica básica o un plato de comida diario, la economía global destina más de 5,6 billones de dólares a financiar guerras, desfiles de moda, megaeventos deportivos, espectáculos musicales, certámenes de belleza y concentraciones religiosas multitudinarias. Lejos de responder a una falta de recursos materiales en el planeta, la persistencia de la miseria humana es el resultado directo de una arquitectura económica que socializa los costos en los presupuestos públicos y privatiza las ganancias en manos de grandes corporaciones e instituciones, legitimando el despilfarro bajo el argumento de que “todo mueve la economía”.


El fenómeno resulta particularmente evidente en los concursos internacionales de belleza como Miss Universo. En pleno siglo XXI, diversos gobiernos continúan desembolsando entre diez y quince millones de dólares únicamente en concepto de canon de franquicia, sumados a millonarios gastos operativos, seguridad y exenciones fiscales para albergar un espectáculo televisivo de apenas unos días. Quienes defienden estas inversiones suelen apelar al supuesto retorno turístico y a la promoción de la marca país; sin embargo, la evidencia económica demuestra que ese argumento funciona más como una herramienta de propaganda política que como una inversión rentable. El flujo temporal de visitantes no altera la estructura productiva ni modifica de forma tangible la balanza comercial del país anfitrión, y el evento no deja ningún tipo de infraestructura permanente ni utilidad social. Mientras el Estado asume el costo de oportunidad de postergar escuelas u hospitales, los ingresos por derechos de transmisión, patrocinios y licencias regresan casi íntegramente a las corporaciones privadas dueñas del certamen.


Esta misma lógica de asimetría financiera se replica a una escala mucho mayor en los megaeventos deportivos como los Juegos Olímpicos. Una investigación de la Saïd Business School de la Universidad de Oxford demostró que todas las ediciones olímpicas celebradas desde 1960 superaron su presupuesto inicial en un promedio del 172% en términos reales, generando riesgos fiscales comparables a los de un desastre natural. Las ciudades anfitrionas cargan con deudas intergeneracionales —como los habitantes de Montreal, que tardaron treinta años en saldar el déficit de los Juegos de 1976, o los contribuyentes de Río de Janeiro y Tokio, cuyas facturas superaron los 13.000 millones de dólares— mientras el Comité Olímpico Internacional retiene los ingresos comerciales libres de impuestos. La toma de conciencia sobre este saqueo al erario público provocó que en 2015 la ciudadanía de Boston, agrupada bajo el movimiento No Boston Olympics, obligara a retirar la candidatura olímpica de Estados Unidos, desatando un efecto dominó que llevó a ciudades como Hamburgo, Roma, Budapest y Calgary a rechazar ser sedes.


A este engranaje se suma el monumental flujo de dinero público y privado que movilizan los megaeventos y organizaciones religiosas alrededor del mundo. De acuerdo con un estudio de la Universidad de Georgetown, la economía vinculada al sector religioso alcanza un volumen global cercano a los cuatro billones de dólares anuales entre propiedades inmobiliarias, exenciones impositivas, donaciones y servicios asociados, de los cuales cientos de miles de millones se destinan cada año específicamente a peregrinaciones, cumbres, giras y espectáculos de fe. En el mundo islámico, la peregrinación anual del Hach a La Meca moviliza a millones de fieles y genera más de 10.000 millones de dólares en apenas diez días de logística, transporte y tasas estatales, según registros de la Cámara de Comercio de La Meca. En el ámbito católico, cada gira apostólica de un sumo pontífice demanda decenas de millones de dólares financiados en gran medida con fondos estatales de seguridad, montaje y contratación directa —como ocurrió recientemente con los 25 a 30 millones de dólares invertidos para la visita del papa León XIV en Sudamérica—, mientras que las megaiglesias evangélicas y pentecostales operan como verdaderos conglomerados mediáticos y de entretenimiento que recaudan miles de millones de dólares libres de impuestos mediante eventos masivos en estadios, redes televisivas y campañas de recaudación bajo la llamada teología de la prosperidad, tal como documentaron investigaciones de BBC News sobre las finanzas de los televangelistas.

author: Acratosaurio rex
title: ¿Vas a votar? Lo dudo
content:
Vale, pasó la Huelga General y vienen las elecciones. Antes de la huelga un montón de gente nos recordaba que disfrutamos de muchas conquistas del Movimiento Obrero, y que no se lograron con buzones de sugerencias, y que hay que luchar.

Pues ya no se acuerdan de eso ¿Que qué nos dicen ahora?: que tenemos que ir a votar a la izquierda, estudiando minuciosamente el reparto de escaños por provincia.

¿Por qué será que esa lógica no me convence? El Parlamento Español, ha sido desde que se constituyó, de derechas. El elector español es mayoritariamente, un personaje reaccionario. Pensar que el PSOE es de izquierdas, cuando ha gobernado 29 años y medio desde las primeras elecciones democráticas de 1977, es tener muy poca idea de lo que es la izquierda.

Os lo voy a contar. La izquierda nació para: 1º lograr que los trabajadores tengan más poder para decidir sobre la riqueza que producen, y sobre las condiciones en que trabajan o viven; 2º redistribuir la riqueza; 3º Limitar la concentración del poder económico.

Ninguno de esos tres puntos ha estado en la agenda del PSOE. Actualmente la concentración de riqueza en manos de los ricos sigue en aumento (dice el Banco de España), y la participación de los trabajadores en las decisiones políticas, es absolutamente… Nula. Cero. Nada. De hecho se ha tenido que hacer una Huelga General para que el Gobierno apunte en el cuaderno de proyectos “ver un día de estos qué se hace con lo de los pisos y alquileres, y comprar gas mostaza pa la poli, que se ha acabado”.

Pero, vamos allá. De ir a votar, ¿a qué partido votaría? Pues a Adelante Andalucía. Tienen de portavoz a un tipo simpático, que habla bien y que tiene un montón de propuestas que me parecen interesantes. Dice que se puede hacer una Ley que acabe con la especulación inmobiliaria… Ah. Tiene pensada una Ley. Yo quiero ver el borrador del proyecto de Ley. ¿Existe? Me temo que no. ¿Para qué se van a molestar en redactar una Ley, si aspiran a lograr si acaso dos o tres diputados? Y también quiero saber –si tal proyecto existe–, cómo piensan llevarlo a cabo. Claro, no pueden. Son tres.

Vamos, que van al Parlamento de mascota. La voz discrepante que les canta las verdades del barquero a los señoritos, que mientras son increpados se echan unas risitas.

Si. Los fachas encorbatados, se guasean de nosaltres. Por eso yo estoy convencido de que la única manera de hablarles… Bueno, yo estoy convencido de que si abren las tripas de uno de esos diputados, huele peor una mezcla de aguas residuales y diarrea caliente, con calamares de cuando se descongeló el frigorífico estando de vacaciones. Y pienso que la única manera sutil de tratar a esa banda, consistiría en agarrar a esos cabrones por las piernas y frotarles el culo con una lija gruesa hasta que salga humo. Lo mismo entonces hacen hasta una Ley acorde con nuestras necesidades.

¿Vas a votar para frenar al fascio? Lo dudo (1).

Conste en acta: si votas será por otros motivos, porque mientras más elecciones hay, más fachas aparecen. Y si no votas, lo mismo es que estás desganao. Por cierto desde 1977 el PSOE gobernó veintinueve años y medio, el PP 14 años, y la UCD 5 años. Y aquí estamos. Echa las cuentas.

Inicie sesión o regístrese para comentar

author: infolibre
title: Συγκέντρωση για την υπόθεση του Κάτω Πολυτεχνείου Νοέμβρη ’20, Δευτέρα 16/11 9:00 Εφετείο Αθηνών
content:
ΓΙΑ ΤΗ ΔΙΚΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΚΚΕΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΠΟΛΥΤΕΧΝΕΙΟΥ ΤΙΣ ΜΕΡΕΣ ΤΗΣ ΚΑΡΑΝΤΙΝΑΣ, 13 ΝΟΕΜΒΡΗ ΤΟΥ 2020


Στις 11 Νοέμβρη 2020 ανακοινώθηκε από το Υπουργείο Προστασίας του Πολίτη και από τον τότε πρύτανη του ΕΜΠ, Αντρέα Μπουντουβή, lock out του ιστορικού Πολυτεχνείου για το διάστημα 13 με 19 Νοεμβρίου, με σκοπό να μην πραγματοποιηθούν οι προγραμματισμένες εκδηλώσεις μνήμης που γίνονται εκεί κάθε χρόνο και η συσπείρωση κόσμου μέσα σε αυτό. Ταυτόχρονα, αναστέλλεται το άρθρο 11 του Συντάγματος για τις συναθροίσεις άνω των 4 ατόμων, ενώ απαγορεύονται και οι επετειακές πορείες της 17 Νοέμβρη και στη συνέχεια της 6ης Δεκέμβρη.


Στις 12 Νοέμβρη, λοιπόν, δεκάδες αγωνίστριες/ες φοιτήτριες/ές, εργαζόμενοι/ες και άνεργοι/ες, αποφασίσαμε να μπούμε στο χώρο του Πολυτεχνείου με σκοπό να το κρατήσουμε ανοιχτό, σπάζοντας στην πράξη το lock out και τους περιορισμούς που είχαν επιβληθεί. Με συνελεύσεις, μικροφωνικές και μοιράσματα κειμένων κοινοποιήσαμε τη δράση μας αυτή. Λίγες ώρες αφ’ ότου μπήκαμε στο Πολυτεχνείο σχηματίστηκε αστυνομικός κλοιός γύρω από το κτήριο και η προσέλευση του κόσμου κατέστη αδύνατη. Όσα άτομα προσπάθησαν να πλησιάσουν ήρθαν αντιμέτωπα με έλεγχο ή/και το γνωστό 300ρι, το πρόστιμο «εκβιασμού» της καραντίνας. Την επόμενη μέρα, στις 13/11 αστυνομικές δυνάμεις όλων των ειδών εισέβαλλαν στον προαύλιο χώρο του Πολυτεχνείου, εφαρμόζοντας την κατάργηση του ασύλου -για πρώτη φορά από το 1995, και για δεύτερη φορά από το 1973- συλλαμβάνοντας τα 68 άτομα που βρίσκονταν εκεί συγκεντρωμένα. Και τα 68 άτομα, κλειστήκαμε σε μεταγωγικά και στη συνέχεια οδηγηθήκαμε στη ΓΑΔΑ, όπου στοιβαχθήκαμε στους στενούς διαδρόμους και στα κρατητήρια, χωρίς -φυσικά- να τηρηθεί έστω και κατ’ επίφαση κάποιο μέτρο προστασίας από τον ιό, από τους υπαλλήλους της ΕΛΑΣ. Εκεί φάνηκε για άλλη μια φορά ο παραλογισμός του κρατικού μηχανισμού, αφού μας αποδόθηκαν οι κατηγορίες της διασποράς του covid -για τις ώρες που βρεθήκαμε σε προαύλιο, ανοιχτό χώρο, πριν μας στοιβάξουν στη ΓΑΔΑ-, διακοπής και διατάραξης της ομαλής διεξαγωγής της λειτουργίας του ΕΜΠ -ενός πανεπιστημίου για το οποίο είχε κηρυχθεί lock out-, διέγερση σε διάπραξη πλημμελήματος και έκθεσης σε κίνδυνο της δημόσιας ασφάλειας και, τέλος, η κατηγορία της απείθειας. Επιπλέον, σε κάποια άτομα επιβλήθηκε το πρόστιμο των 300 ευρώ για «άσκοπη μετακίνηση», ένα πρόστιμο οικονομικού εκβιασμού που λειτούργησε πολλούς μήνες σαν φόβητρο για τα πιο φτωχά κομμάτια της κοινωνίας, που «τόλμησαν» ή υποχρεώνονταν να μετακινούνται «παράνομα» κατά τη διάρκεια της καραντίνας.


ΣΥΓΚΥΡΙΑ


Οι μνήμες από την περίοδο της πανδημίας είναι ακόμα νωπές, και εύκολα μπορεί κανείς να επαναφέρει στη σκέψη του, το φόβο, την αγωνία για εαυτούς και αγαπημένους, την ασφυξία, και την τρομοκρατία που επικρατούσε εκείνους τους μήνες. Ανάλογα, βέβαια, με το από ποια θέση μιλάει η κάθε μια από εμάς, αυτά τα συναισθήματα έχουν πολύ διαφορετικές αφετηρίες και απολήξεις. Από πολύ νωρίς έγινε εμφανές, ότι η κρατική διαχείριση της κρίσης αυτής θα ήταν αστυνομικού τύπου, και όχι υγειονομικού, κάτι που η πολιτική διαχείριση ποτέ δεν προσπάθησε να κρύψει, αφήνοντας τα νοσοκομεία σε συνθήκες οριακά πολεμικές, εκβιάζοντας τους/τις εργαζόμενους/ες στον κλάδο της υγείας και οδηγώντας τους στα όρια της εξαθλίωσης, την ίδια ώρα που οι προσλήψεις αστυνομικών αυξήθηκαν κατά χιλιάδες και η άγρια καταστολή οποιασδήποτε διαμαρτυρίας ή εναντίωσης στις κυβερνητικές επιλογές ήταν δεδομένη. Στα πλαίσια αυτά, με πρόφαση τη συνθήκη «έκτακτης ανάγκης», η επιβολή της καραντίνας δεν αποτέλεσε μέτρο υγειονομικό, αλλά μέτρο κοινωνικής πειθάρχησης, αφού η απαγόρευση της κυκλοφορίας, των συναντήσεων, των διαδηλώσεων, η επιβολή της κοινωνικής αποστασιοποίησης και ο εγκλεισμός στο σπίτι, σε συνάρτηση με την υποστελέχωση, υποχρηματοδότηση και πλήρη υποβάθμιση του ΕΣΥ, σε καμία περίπτωση δεν προώθησε τη δημόσια υγεία παρά ενέτεινε τον κοινωνικό έλεγχο των εκμεταλλευόμενων. Πόσες εκατοντάδες άνθρωποι έχασαν τη ζωή τους λόγω της κατάρρευσης του ΕΣΥ; Πόσοι μετανάστες και μετανάστριες εγκαταλείφθηκαν στη μοίρα τους στα στρατόπεδα συγκέντρωσης, παρατημένοι σε άθλιες συνθήκες διαβίωσης; Πόσοι κρατούμενοι και κρατούμενες στοιβάχθηκαν στην απομόνωση και στερήθηκαν τα επισκεπτήρια των αγαπημένων τους με πρόφαση τη διασπορά του Covid-19, βλέποντας ανθρώπους να αργοπεθαίνουν στο διπλανό κελί, εγκαταλελειμμένοι/ες στην αρρώστια; Πόσες γυναίκες εγκλωβίστηκαν σε τέσσερεις τοίχους με τους κακοποιητές τους, εκτιθέμενες στην έμφυλη βία υπό τις κυβερνητικές εντολές του «μένουμε σπίτι»; Πόσα …

author: infolibre
title: Καμία δίωξη στον κόσμο του αγώνα, τη Δευτέρα 16/11, 09:00, στα Δικαστήρια Χανίων
content:
Κάλεσμα/Αφίσα από την

ανοιχτή συνέλευση για την κρατική δολοφονία του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη:


Καμία δίωξη στον κόσμο του αγώνα – Ενημέρωση από τα δικαστήρια το Οκτωβρίου και ανανέωση καλέσματος


Δευτέρα 16 Νοεμβρίου | 09:00 | Δικαστήρια Χανίων


Από το καλοκαίρι του 2024, οι 4 μπάτσοι δολοφόνοι του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη έχουν κατηγορηθείγια ανθρωποκτονία με ενδεχόμενο δόλο σε ήρεμη ψυχική κατάσταση από κοινού. Μόλις τουςτελευταίους 10 μήνες, η υπόθεση ξυλοδαρμού μέχρι θανάτου του Κωστή προχώρησε στην κύριαανάκριση, που κατέληξε στην επιβολή στους δολοφόνους απαγόρευση εξόδου από τη χώρα καιεγγυήσεις 20.000€ για τους 2 μπάτσους και 5.000€ για τους άλλους 2. Και ενώ το αμέσως επόμενοδιάστημα αναμένεται να ξεκινήσει η δίκη των μπάτσων δολοφόνων, εκείνοι παραμένουν στιςθέσεις τους, ένοπλοι, ενεργώντας μέχρι και σήμερα «τυχαίους» ελέγχους.


Η ανοχή και η επιβράβευση του κράτους στα δολοφονικά εγκλήματα των ένστολων φονιάδων του,έρχεται (και) μέσω του δικαστικού συστήματος: Μέχρι και σήμερα, τους έχει δώσει το ελεύθερο ναμηνύουν με κάθε τρόπο τον κόσμο που αγωνίζεται, από τους συγγενείς του Κωστή μέχρι τα μέλητης ανοιχτής συνέλευσης. Αντί, λοιπόν, να προχωράει ο προγραμματισμός της δίκης γιαανθρωποκτονία από πρόθεση, προχωράνε οι μηνύσεις που κάνουν οι ίδιοι οι δολοφόνοι. Περιττό ναπούμε πως στην περίπτωση που στη θέση των μπάτσων, κατηγορούνταν κάποιος«φτωχοδιάβολος», οι διαδικασίες θα κινούνταν με γρήγορους ρυθμούς.


Τα δικαστικά ραντεβού του προηγούμενου μήνα δεν προχώρησαν:


• Η δίκη στις 14/10

 με κατηγορούμενο τον αδερφό του Κωστή Μανιουδάκη, μετά από τημήνυση της Κωνσταντίνας Μόσχου (μία εκ των τεσσάρων μπάτσων δολοφόνων)αναβλήθηκε.


• Στις 20/10, αναβλήθηκε επίσης η εξέταση για τα ασφαλιστικά μέτρα

 κατά της Μαρίας,συζύγου του Κωστή, μετά από προσφυγή του μπάτσου δολοφόνου Μανώλη Γεωργιάδη. Ηαναβολή αποφασίστηκε μετά από αίτημα του τελευταίου λόγω ασθενείας.


• Στις 21/10, είχε οριστεί η δίκη για τα 4 μέλη της ανοιχτής συνέλευσης που μήνυσε ο Μ.Γεωργιάδης το 2024, επειδή όταν τον είδαν να σκίζει τις αφίσες μας και, χωρίς ναγνωρίζουν ποιος είναι, τις υπερασπίστηκαν. Για αυτήν την υπόθεση, έχουν οριστεί τουςπροηγούμενους μήνες 3 δικάσιμοι στις οποίες ο Γεωργιάδης δεν εμφανίστηκε.

Σε αυτή τη δικάσιμο ο μπάτσος δολοφόνος εμφανίστηκε για πρώτη φορά αυτοπροσώπως στην αίθουσα του δικαστηρίου

, παρ’ όλο που μία μέρα πριν είχε ζητήσει αναβολή, βρισκόμενοςστην πρώτη ημέρα τετραήμερης αναρρωτικής άδειας.

Η συνεδρίαση διεκόπη για τις 16/11.


Ανανεώνουμε το κάλεσμά μας για τη Δευτέρα 16 Νοέμβρη, σε αλληλεγγύη με τα 4 συντρόφια πουκατηγορούνται. Κάθε τέτοια υπόθεση, είναι μια ευκαιρία να επαναφέρουμε στο προσκήνιο τηνυπόθεση και να επαναλάβουμε πως

οι μπάτσοι των ΤΑΕ Σούδας Στέλιος Λιανιδάκης, Μανώλης Γεωργιάδης, Κωνσταντίνα Μόσχου και Σήφης Τσιχλάκης δολοφόνησαν τον Κώστα Μανιουδάκη.

title: Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στη 12χρονη επιζώσα της υπόθεσης Κολωνού, Δευτέρα 16/11, στις 09.00, στο Εφετείο Αθηνών
content:
Καλέσματα/Αφίσες:


Το Σπίτι για την Ενδυνάμωση και τη Χειραφέτηση


ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑ ΣΕ ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗ ΑΛΛΗΛΕΓΓΥΗΣ


ΔΕΥΤΕΡΑ 16 ΝΟΕΜΒΡΗ, 09:00


ΕΦΕΤΕΙΟ ΑΘΗΝΩΝ, Κυρίλλου Λουκάρεως 14


Η δίκη σε δεύτερο βαθμό για την υπόθεση τράφικινγκ του Κολωνού ξεκινά ξανά στις 16 Νοεμβρίου.


Θα βρεθούμε συλλογικά εκεί.


Γιατί δε ξεχνάμε. Γιατί δε συνηθίζουμε τη φρίκη. Γιατί δεν πρόκειται να αφήσουμε μια επιζώσα παιδικής σεξουαλικής κακοποίησης και την οικογένειά της μόνα απέναντι στους τραφικερς, τους παιδοβιαστες, τους κακοποιητές, τους εκμεταλλευτές και τους μηχανισμούς που τους προστατεύουν και τους συγκαλύπτουν.


Η υπόθεση του Κολωνού είναι η απόδειξη της σύνδεσης της πατριαρχικής βίας με την ταξική εκμετάλλευση, της εμπορευματοποίησης των σωμάτων και της κοινωνικής ανισότητας. Καταδεικνύει τους μηχανισμούς μέσα από τους οποίους τα πιο ευάλωτα σώματα γίνονται αντικείμενα εκμετάλλευσης, ενώ όσα τολμούν να μιλήσουν έρχονται αντιμέτωπα με την αμφισβήτηση, την ενοχοποίηση και τον εκφοβισμό.


Από την πρώτη στιγμή, η αντιμετώπιση της μητέρας από τις αστυνομικές αρχές, η καθυστέρηση στην κινητοποίηση για τη σύλληψη του παιδοβιαστή και τράφικερ Μίχου και η προσπάθεια μετατόπισης των ευθυνών προς την οικογένεια έδειξαν για ακόμη μια φορά τη γνώριμη λειτουργία των κρατικών μηχανισμών: την απαξίωση των επιζώντων και την προστασία των σχέσεων εξουσίας. Η πατριαρχία αναπαράγεται μέσα από τους θεσμούς εξουσίας, μέσα από πρακτικές και κοινωνικές αντιλήψεις που καλλιεργούν τη σιωπή, το φόβο, συγκαλύπτουν τη βία και τιμωρούν όσα καταγγέλλουν.


Οι καταγγελίες για περιστατικά εκφοβισμού της οικογένειας καθιστούν ακόμη πιο επιτακτική την ανάγκη να μην αφήσουμε κανένα μόνο. Κανένας κρατικός μηχανισμός, κανένας μπάτσος, κανένας κακοποιητής δεν έχει το δικαίωμα να τρομοκρατεί παιδιά και να μετατρέπει την καθημερινότητά τους σε πεδίο απειλής και φόβου.


Το Εφετείο είναι ένα ακόμη πεδίο σύγκρουσης, όπου θα επιχειρηθεί να αμφισβητηθεί η πρωτόδικη απόφαση, να ανατραπούν καταδίκες και να μεταφερθεί για ακόμη μια φορά το βάρος στην οικογένεια της επιζώσας. Δεν έχουμε αυταπάτες για το ρόλο της αστικής δικαιοσύνης, ούτε αναμένουμε τη δικαίωσή μας από τους θεσμούς που συντηρούν τις σχέσεις ανισότητας και καταπίεσης.


Απέναντι στην πατριαρχία, την κρατική καταστολή, την ταξική βία και την κουλτούρα του βιασμού, αντιτάσσουμε την αυτοοργάνωση, και την αλληλεγγύη από τα κάτω, δημιουργώντας συλλογικά δίκτυα φροντίδας και αντίστασης.


Η παρουσία μας στο Εφετείο είναι μέρος αυτού του αγώνα. Είναι μια πολιτική θέση απέναντι στην κανονικοποίηση της έμφυλης βίας και της παιδικής εκμετάλλευσης. Είναι η άρνησή μας να αποδεχτούμε ότι η φτώχεια, η κοινωνική θέση και η έμφυλη καταπίεση καθορίζουν ποια σώματα μπορούν να κακοποιούνται και ποια στόματα πρέπει να μένουν κλειστά.


Στεκόμαστε δίπλα στη 12χρονη επιζώσα, στα αδέρφια της, στη μητέρα της, απέναντι στην οργανωμένη βία της εξουσίας.


Να βρεθούμε ξανά στο δρόμο και έξω από τις δικαστικές αίθουσες. Να χτίσουμε συλλογικά αναχώματα απέναντι στον εκφοβισμό και τη συγκάλυψη.

title: Reapertura de Kúlmine, espacio antiautoritario
content:
Con convicción y entusiasmo nos alegramos de poder anunciar la reapertura del espacio Kúlmine. Pretendemos que éste sea otro lugar de encuentro de lxs antiautoritarixs en la región, como así también de quienes, aún no reconociéndose como tales, compartan con nosotrxs el espíritu autogestivo, de ayuda mutua y oposición a la sociedad autoritaria. Enfocadxs en la autoformación individual y colectiva y empeñadxs en afilar nuestras ideas constantemente como momento necesario de la lucha: pondremos a circular nuevamente los libros y publicaciones de nuestra biblioteca, abriremos talleres y charlas, y recibiremos las propuestas que, viniendo desde fuera del colectivo, colaboren en este empeño.

Para celebrar este nuevo inicio, lxs invitamos a una velada de reapertura, en la cual confraternizar y compartir arte en vivo, conocer las publicaciones de editoriales de compañerxs y asistir a la presentación del libro «Ningún-ningún», sobre el movimiento de ocupaciones de centros de estudio en Uruguay, en los años 96-97 del siglo pasado, para la cual contaremos con algunxs de sus autores.

Sean bienvenidxs quienes quieran acercarse a compartir esta velada, el Viernes 20 de Noviembre a partir de las 18:30 hs. en Kúlmine. Saludos a quienes en este y otros territorios mantienen proyectos antagónicos al poder y el capital. Las puertas están abiertas para el intercambio, la comunicación y coordinación.

Kúlmine espacio antiautoritario. Cumbres de Neptunia. Canelones. Territorio usurpado por el estado uruguayo.

Dossier


„

Den Berichten zufolge soll die im BAföG enthaltene Wohnpauschale von 250 auf 325 Euro erhöht werden. „In vielen Hochschulstädten ist auch dafür keine Studentenbude anzumieten“, unterstrich Keller. (…) Die BAföG-Erhöhung müsse möglichst vielen Studierenden zugutekommen und schnell wirksam werden. Deshalb sei auch ein deutlicher Anstieg der Eltern-Freibeträge um mindestens 15 Prozent notwendig

Armutsrisiko Studium: BAföG hält mit den Lebenshaltungskosten nicht Schritt – Bundesweiter Aktionstag BAföG am 17.11., International Students Day

author: Julius Gavroche
title: Our founder: Charlotte Wilson
content:
Charlotte Wilson at Newnham College, Cambridge, c.1873


From our 140th anniversary issue, an appreciation of the unfairly obscured anarchist and her profound legacy


punkacademic, from

Freedom News

, 15/11/2026


“The key-note of the anarchist contention is that the vitiation of social life is produced by the domination of man by man. The spirit of domination is the disintegrating element, which, constantly tending to break up society, is the fundamental cause of confusion and disorder.” So wrote Charlotte Wilson in July 1886 – a few months before she and a group of others founded the Freedom newspaper and in turn Freedom Press.


Aside from the gendered language, Wilson’s analysis still has relevance today, as does her writing. Her emphasis on the role of domination in disrupting the social relations to which she felt human beings naturally inclined would find its echoes in more recent times.


In 1982, Murray Bookchin spoke of domination as the fundamental vice to which his social ecology stood opposed. “The domination of nature by man”, wrote Bookchin, in his

Ecology of Freedom

, “stems from the very real domination of human by human”. Bookchin paid tribute to a litany of male writers – Weber, Horkheimer, Adorno, Polanyi, and Kropotkin. He also named his “favourite Utopian” – Wilson’s former friend and comrade, William Morris. But of Wilson, mention came there none.


Bookchin’s assertion that before the 1960s “domination” and “hierarchy” would have been unfamiliar terms on the left would have seemed strange to Wilson. Despite the best efforts of scholars such as Susan Hinely, Hermia Oliver and our own Nicolas Walter in the decades since Bookchin, Wilson remains unfairly obscured. And yet her legacy – not least the enduring one of this periodical itself – was profound.


Born in 1854 in Worcestershire, Charlotte “Lettie” Martin (as she was before marriage) was solidly middle-class, born into an era of religious upheaval, scientific discovery, and political and economic change.


It was a period of huge extremes of wealth and poverty; Dickens’s

Hard Times

 was published the same year Lettie was born, its soulless Mr Gradgrind as the epitome of drudgery and conformity. Lettie – our Charlotte Wilson – would not do conformity.


Hinely notes that Wilson’s heritage was evangelical, and that religious sentiment pervaded her upbringing even as she repudiated the church in favour of her secular faiths – socialism in general, and anarchism in particular. But religious language and a sense of mission characterises her writing.


She was from her youth a rebel. Her gender meant she could not vote nor receive a degree in the ancient universities where her male peers might venture. She went anyway – to Cambridge, as one of the first women to attend classes there. Married in 1876 to Arthur Wilson, a stockbroker, she lived in London and cultivated a wide intellectual circle on the left. Cambridge had been a transformative experience for her and, as Hinely shows, gave her an understanding of social science which accelerated her transition to socialist politics.


She was radicalised by a series of incidents in the 1880s. The Lyon Trial of the 66—which amounted to a purge of anarchists by the French governmen—saw the famous writer Peter Kropotkin and many others jailed for purported membership of the Black International, and was widely discussed in the press. Wilson spoke French, often travelled to France, and read Kropotkin and Elisee Reclus as she was taking her steps into the fluid socialist circles of London in the 1880s.


By 1885, she was a self-declared anarchist and penning articles for periodicals under the pseudonym ‘An English Anarchist’. By early 1886 she was in touch with Sophie Kropotkin, Peter’s wife, and following his release encouraged the family to move to London where the Kropotkins settled for the next several decades in exile.


She had resolved to found a new anarchist paper, focused on propaganda for anarchist socialism—Wilson was herself an anarchist communist—and with Kropotkin on board she took up the reins as the paper’s first editor. There is not space here to do justice to all her achievements, but she edited the paper for most of the next decade.


Her most substantive legacy is the establishment and survival of

Freedom

 at a time when other anarchist journals foundered. But she was more than that. Wilson has been a victim of “manarchism” as Ruth Kinna has called it, or the tendency for men …

author: Julius Gavroche
title: Remembering “remembrance day” with Randolph Bourne
content:
It cannot be too firmly realized that war is a function of States and not of nations, indeed that it is the chief function of States. War is a very artificial thing. It is not the naive spontaneous outburst of herd pugnacity; it is no more primary than is formal religion. War cannot exist without a military establishment, and a military establishment cannot exist without a State organization. War has an immemorial tradition and heredity only because the State has a long tradition and heredity. But they are inseparably and functionally joined. We cannot crusade against war without crusading implicitly against the State. And we cannot expect, or take measures to ensure, that this war is a war to end war, unless at the same time we take measures to end the State in its traditional form. The State is not the nation, and the State can be modified and even abolished in its present form, without harming the nation. On the contrary, with the passing of the dominance of the State, the genuine life-enhancing forces of the nation will be liberated. If the State’s chief function is war, then the State must suck out of the nation a large part of its energy for purely sterile purposes of defense and aggression. It devotes to waste or to actual destruction as much as it can of the vitality of the nation. No one will deny that war is a vast complex of life-destroying and life-crippling forces. If the State’s chief function is war, then it is chiefly concerned with coordinating and developing the powers and techniques which make for destruction. And this means not only the actual and potential destruction of the enemy, but of the nation at home as well. For the very existence of a State in a system of States means that the nation lies always under a risk of war and invasion, and the calling away of energy into military pursuits means a crippling of the productive and life-enhancing process of the national life.


The State

 (1919)


Randolph Bourne


from

The Anarchist Library

: “Randolph Bourne left an unfinished, unpaginated draft of

The State

 when he died during the flu pandemic of 1918. The draft was published posthumously, with some material incorrectly ordered, in

Untimely Papers

 (1919). This edition follows the corrected ordering used in most printed editions of Bourne’s work.”


I.


To most Americans of the classes which consider themselves significant the war brought a sense of the sanctity of the State which, if they had had time to think about it, would have seemed a sudden and surprising alteration in their habits of thought. In times of peace, we usually ignore the State in favour of partisan political controversies, or personal struggles for office, or the pursuit of party policies. It is the Government rather than the State with which the politically minded are concerned. The State is reduced to a shadowy emblem which comes to consciousness only on occasions of patriotic holiday.


Government is obviously composed of common and unsanctified men, and is thus a legitimate object of criticism and even contempt. If your own party is in power, things may be assumed to be moving safely enough; but if the opposition is in, then clearly all safety and honor have fled the State. Yet you do not put it to yourself in quite that way. What you think is only that there are rascals to be turned out of a very practical machinery of offices and functions which you take for granted. When we say that Americans are lawless, we usually mean that they are less conscious than other peoples of the august majesty of the institution of the State as it stands behind the objective government of men and laws which we see. In a republic the men who hold office are indistinguishable from the mass. Very few of them possess the slightest personal dignity with which they could endow their political role; even if they ever thought of such a thing. And they have no class distinction to give them glamour. In a republic the Government is obeyed grumblingly, because it has no bedazzlements or sanctities to gild it. If you are a good old-fashioned democrat, you rejoice at this fact, you glory in the plainness of a system where every citizen has become a king. If you are more sophisticated you bemoan the passing of dignity and honor from affairs of State. But in practice, the democrat does not in the least treat his elected citizen with the respect due to a king, nor does the sophisticated citizen pay tribute to the dignity even when he finds it …

author: Novara Media
title: Britain Needs an Entirely New Political System. Here’s Why.
content:
Ask anyone in the UK what they think about politics, and they’ll tell you politicians are not to be trusted, and that politics itself is broken. Our institutions, from the Treasury to the House of Lords and the Privy Council, are among the oldest in the world. It is a system better fit for a monarchy, than a modern democracy.


Investigative journalist Adam Ramsay has spent the last decade dissecting the apparatus of the British state. The conclusion he has come to in his new book, Abolish Westminster, is that we do just that. On Downstream this week, he tells Aaron Bastani why and how to do so.


What exactly are the Privy Council, the House of Lords, the Treasury, and who do they serve? Is it normal that so many members of our political system are on the payroll of foreign interests? How have other countries gone about updating their constitutions? And is ending the union the best way to abolish Westminster?

author: Julius Gavroche
title: “How Has Serving Impacted You?”
content:
Dulce et Decorum Est

 (1920)


Bent double, like old beggars under sacks,

Knock-kneed, coughing like hags, we cursed through sludge,

Till on the haunting flares we turned our backs,

And towards our distant rest began to trudge.

Men marched asleep. Many had lost their boots,

But limped on, blood-shod. All went lame; all blind;

Drunk with fatigue; deaf even to the hoots

Of gas-shells dropping softly behind.


Gas! GAS! Quick, boys!—An ecstasy of fumbling

Fitting the clumsy helmets just in time,

But someone still was yelling out and stumbling

And flound’ring like a man in fire or lime.—

Dim through the misty panes and thick green light,

As under a green sea, I saw him drowning.


In all my dreams before my helpless sight,

He plunges at me, guttering, choking, drowning.


If in some smothering dreams, you too could pace

Behind the wagon that we flung him in,

And watch the white eyes writhing in his face,

His hanging face, like a devil’s sick of sin;

If you could hear, at every jolt, the blood

Come gargling from the froth-corrupted lungs,

Obscene as cancer, bitter as the cud

Of vile, incurable sores on innocent tongues,—

My friend, you would not tell with such high zest

To children ardent for some desperate glory,

The old Lie:

Dulce et decorum est

Pro patria mori

 [Horace: It is sweet and fitting to die for one’s country].


Wilfred Owen


Veterans of the US Military in Their Own Words


from the

CrimethInc.

 collective, 11/11/2026


What is it like to serve in the United States military? If only it were possible for those who are considering enlisting to learn the unvarnished truth. In 2019, a viral

tweet

 from the official US Army twitter account unexpectedly drew over 11,000 candid replies in the course of 48 hours. These responses offer a rare window into the real experiences of servicemembers and veterans. We present a selection of them here for the benefit of anyone who is thinking about joining the military.


This is a document of an

earlier era

 of social media, captured here before it

vanishes

. You can obtain a book collecting the first twenty-four hours of responses

here

.


Just before Memorial Day in 2019, the United States Army made a strategic blunder almost on par with invading Vietnam. They posted this inquiry on their official Twitter account:


In response, veterans and their family and friends posted thousands upon thousands of tweets recounting broken promises and broken people. They described cancer, PTSD, domestic abuse, unpaid college and housing loans, Gulf War syndrome, insomnia, sexual abuse, poverty, Agent Orange, racism, nightmare disorder, unemployment, burying loved ones, misogyny, orphaned children, burn pit syndrome, homelessness, debilitating injuries, divorce, alcoholism, disappearances, a Veterans Affairs department that was unwilling or unable to help, and suicide, suicide, suicide.


The United States military is one of the largest concentrations of power in the world. With

tens of thousands

 of missiles,

millions

 of firearms, and over

5000

 nuclear weapons—about 40% of all the nuclear weapons in the world—the US military can hold the entire world hostage.


The US military is also the largest employer in the United States,

employing

 almost 2,900,000 workers—roughly 17 out of every 2000 people. If we add private military contractors like Blackwater (250,000 workers), the employees of non-combat support companies like Halliburton who build military infrastructure, provide food, and the like (150,000-250,000), US-based war manufacturers like Lockheed Martin and Boeing (1,500,000), and

veterans

 who receive disability or pension payments (2,000,000), we find that roughly 1 out of every 50 Americans is economically dependent on US militarism.


As in all industries, without this workforce, the military would grind to a halt. It especially depends on regular transfusions of young blood—young people sold stories about adventure, duty, and upward mobility.


If we were to ask new recruits why they joined, we’d

likely

 hear a mix of narratives about gaining strength, seeing the world, paying for college, serving God and country, learning life skills, continuing a family tradition, escaping poverty or an unsafe home, obtaining housing, having fun, and protecting loved ones. Most people join the military because they think it will benefit them or because they believe they are serving a higher calling.

title: Torino: “La mobilitazione non si arresta” comunicato dell’ Assemblea di Palazzo Nuovo
content:
Ripubblichiamo il comunicato dell’

Assemblea di Palazzo Nuovo

 a seguito dell’incidente avvenuto nella notte di giovedì e che ha visto coinvolti due compagni writers che in ogni occasione portano il loro prezioso contributo artistico alle lotte e ai movimenti. Esprimiamo vicinanza e pronta guarigione e consigliamo la lettura delle riflessioni degli studenti e studentesse universitarie  sul tema della sicurezza.


Tanto si millanta sulla presunta sicurezza, eppure quella che dovrebbe essere garantita dagli organi istituzionali e dagli organismi di governance non l’abbiamo mai concretamente riscontrata.


Prendiamo atto di quanto accaduto questa notte e riconosciamo pienamente la rilevanza e la gravità degli avvenimenti. Non intendiamo negare, minimizzare né sottrarci a quanto successo: siamo consapevoli della serietà della situazione, siamo in contatto con le persone coinvolte e ci stiamo assumendo la responsabilità di affrontare e gestire le conseguenze di quanto accaduto.


È fin troppo facile strumentalizzare un episodio come quello di questa notte per alimentare una narrazione di falsa sicurezza, quella stessa sicurezza che, secondo i nostri ministri, dovrebbe essere rappresentata dal manifesto sottoscritto il 20 ottobre 2026 da Bernini e Crosetto. Un accordo che dietro la retorica della cosiddetta «cultura della sicurezza», prefigura un progressivo avvicinamento tra il comparto della difesa, l’ambito militare e il sistema universitario, rafforzando logiche militariste e guerrafondaie all’interno degli spazi della formazione e della ricerca.


Dov’è la sicurezza quando si parla di amianto nelle aule universitarie, di tre morti al giorno sul lavoro, di reparti della celere schierati davanti al Rettorato per impedire lo svolgimento di un presidio, di studenti manganellati e aggrediti durante una contestazione?


Ci teniamo a ribadire che la mobilitazione non si arresta: L’attivazione nei diversi poli universitari proseguirà e, nonostante i tentativi infami di strumentalizzazione degli avvenimenti di queste ore, nulla di quanto accaduto cancella le rivendicazioni elaborate nel corso di queste settimane di occupazione, né il percorso politico che le ha precedute e quello che continuerà a svilupparsi in futuro. I nostri obiettivi continueranno a essere praticati e non intendiamo cedere alle provocazioni mediatiche che tentano di delegittimare il movimento o di distogliere l’attenzione dalla sua reale portata politica: una mobilitazione che mette al centro il contrasto al carovita, alle condizioni di vita sempre più precarie, alla negazione del diritto allo studio e alla militarizzazione degli spazi universitari. Una mobilitazione che si oppone apertamente alle politiche di un governo guerrafondaio, che investe nel riarmo e alimenta logiche di guerra mentre lascia studenti e lavoratori a fare i conti con salari da fame e affitti insostenibili.


Riteniamo inoltre vergognoso che la Prandi, dopo tre settimane di assenza durante le quali si è cercato concretamente di aprire un’interlocuzione e costruire un percorso di dialogo, abbia scelto di contattarci senza nemmeno metterci la faccia, al contrario ha colto l’occasione per intervenire in assemblea tramite una delegazione di professori con fare paternalistico. Un atteggiamento che evidenzia ancora una volta la distanza tra la disponibilità istituzionale dichiarata e la concreta volontà di confrontarsi e dialogare con gli studenti e le studentesse.

Non permetteremo che gli avvenimenti di queste ore diventino un pretesto per oscurare il percorso politico e collettivo costruito in queste settimane.

Infine, riteniamo necessario fornire un chiarimento sulle condizioni delle persone coinvolte nell’incidente: allo stato attuale risultano tutte in condizioni stabili.

author: Unknown
title: Difendere il Bilancione significa proteggere la costa e il suo futuro
content:
Ripubblichiamo una riflessione di Quarticciolo Ribelle e Casale Alba sullo sgombero di questa settimana del Bilancione. Proseguono le iniziative di solidarietà con un corteo per oggi, domenica 15 novembre.


C’è un particolare inquietante nello sgombero di giovedì scorso al Bilancione di Fiumicino.


Oltre all’ingente e ingiustificato spiegamento di forze dell’ordine, a osservare attentamente le operazioni c’era anche l’amministratore delegato di “Fiumicino Waterfront srl”, la società incaricata di costruire il tristemente famoso porto crocieristico per conto di Royal Carribean e Cruise International, due colossi del settore. Nonostante il progetto fosse stato inserito da Governo e Comune di Fiumicino tra le opere “urgenti” in vista di un Giubileo già finito da un pezzo. Nonostante una recente sentenza del TAR abbia dato ragione ai comitati No Porto e abbia annullato la Valutazione di Impatto Ambientale sul progetto.


Come se già non bastasse la chiusura di una lunga esperienza di autogestione cone quella del Bilancione, la presenza allo sgombero dei vertici delle società promotrici del progetto alla foce del Tevere fa riflettere.


Un modo di ribadire che, al di là dei fragili strumenti di tutela a mezzo giudiziario, comanda una logica sola, quella del denaro. Dopo mesi di discussione sui fondi immobiliari per Spin Time, questa è forse una dimostrazione ancora più plastica di come vanno le cose. E questo il futuro che immaginiamo per le nostre citta, per il litorale?


Difendere il Bilancione significa proteggere la costa e il suo futuro Rilanciamo il corteo di domenica alle 15 e il 1 dicembre per il consiglio straordinario del comune di Fiumicino e mandiamo un abbraccio solidale a chi persiste nel mettere tutto in gioco per opporsi a quella logica perversa.


Chi semina porti raccoglie tempesta!

author: Unknown
title: Bologna: l’Archivio dei movimenti di Via Avesella è sotto sfratto. L’appello a salvare la storia di un patrimonio collettivo (e di parte)
content:
Solidarietà all’Archivio di Via Avesella! Condividiamo l’appello a salvare la storia di un patrimonio collettivo e l’approfondimento di

Radio Onda d’Urto

.


Da quasi sessant’anni i locali di 

via Avesella 5/A

 ospitano le attività politiche di collettivi, gruppi, comitati, realtà antagoniste ed extraparlamentari di Bologna. Dal 2020, nei locali di via Avesella è nato

 l’Archivio dei movimenti sociali 

al fine di raccogliere la memoria storica (e di parte) di quel luogo e i documenti al suo interno, rendendoli da allora un patrimonio collettivo. E, ora, l’Archivio è 

a rischio sfratto

.


La storia di Via Avesella arriva da lontano. 

Era il 1969

 quando nasceva in via Avesella la redazione locale del quotidiano Il Manifesto, divenuta poi sede di 

Lotta Continua

 e poi ancora luogo di un numero incalcolabile di collettivi, realtà politiche, redazioni di riviste che lo hanno attraversato, arrivando poi negli anni ’80 a diventare sede dell’

Autonomia

.


In questo luogo visse momenti significativi della sua militanza anche 

Francesco Lorusso

, studente universitario di Medicina e militante di Lotta Continua assassinato in via Mascarella sotto il piombo dei carabinieri l’11 marzo del 1977. La sera del 10 marzo, il giorno prima di essere ucciso, Francesco Lorusso si trovava nella sede di via Avesella per una riunione.


Negli anni successivi, Via Avesella ha ospitato il nodo bolognese di 

ECN (European Counter Network)

, la prima rete telematica autogestita dei movimenti antagonisti italiani ed europei, attiva tra la fine degli anni ’80 e gli anni ’90.


Durante l’ultimo decennio del ‘900 i locali di Via Avesella hanno ospitato la sede del 

Comitato Senza Frontiere

, attivo nella difesa delle prime lotte dei migranti in Italia, e il 

Collettivo Immaginazione

, realtà culturale e mediatica attiva a Bologna che curò un documentario sulla scena rap emergente all’epoca.


Arrivando all’oggi, 

l’Archivio dei movimenti sociali di Via Avesella 5/a è a rischio sgombero

. L’affitto non sarà più rinnovato dal 1° novembre 2027 perchè un fondo immobiliare vuole appropriarsene. Il luogo che conserva la memoria dei movimenti e che è divenuto con l’Archivio un patrimonio collettivo dall’inestimabile valore è sotto sfratto proprio nell’anno in cui si celebra il 50° anniversario del ’77 e dell’uccisione di Francesco Lorusso. Per questo è stata lanciata un’

assemblea pubblica

 in programma domenica 29 novembre, alle 16, in via Avesella 5/a.


Radio Onda d’Urto ne ha parlato con Stefania, dell’Archivio dei movimenti sociali di Via Avesella.

author: Unknown
title: Lo sporco accordo tra università e Telt
content:
Ripubblichiamo l’articolo uscito su

Notav.info


UNITO SVENDE LA RICERCA A FABBRICHE DI DISTRUZIONE


Il 3 novembre è stato discusso in Senato Accademico un 

nuovo accordo quadro tra TELT

, l’azienda che progetta, realizza e gestisce i cantieri della tratta transfrontaliera della Torino-Lione, e 

Unito

.


L’accordo, che è passato con solamente due voti contrari, ha approvato una collaborazione tra TELT e l’università di ricerca, in cui 

UniTo è riconosciuto come alleato strategico

.


Purtroppo questa non è di certo una novità: negli anni UniTo ha già incassato soldi da TELT per la ricerca. Nel database dei progetti dell’Ateneo si possono trovare tra gi altri, una Convenzione quadro tra il Dip. di Giurisprudenza e la TELT sas; attiva dal 2017 al 2018 con TELT come ente finanziatore. Ma anche un accordo attuativo per un progetto dal titolo piuttosto esplicito: “

L’impresa plurinazionale come risorsa e sfida. Il caso TELT

“, in coprogettazione tra Giurisprudenza, Culture Politica e Società e TELT stessa. 


In più dal 2025, nel Dip. di Scienze Agrarie, Forestali e Ambientali, è stato aperto un progetto, finanziato dall’Unione Europea, per “

investire nella tutela e valorizzazione della biodiversità per una maggiore connessione tra città e montagna

“. Da questo studio è nato un volume divulgativo “

La biodiversità della flora in Val Clarea

”, testo che 

TELT rivendica come prova dell’impegno aziendale per “la tutela e il monitoraggio della biodiversità”

.


La 

palese ipocrisia

 di questi accordi dimostra come rappresentino uno 

strumento per sfruttare il sapere accademico

. Mascherano una volontà che però deve essere chiarita: 

TELT vuole continuare impunemente a speculare sulla devastazione e sulla distruzione dei territori

. Come può un’azienda che da 30 anni devasta una valle, cementificando, disboscando, inquinando le acque, espropriando le persone dalle loro case, proporre “attività di monitoraggio ambientale, tutela della biodiversità e ricerca scientifica”?


Non è ricerca libera: è ricerca pagata da una parte in causa.


Non si può accettare che sia TELT a dare la committenza di studi su effetti ambientali, sociali e di salute pubblica di cui essa è la prima artefice del danno. Una 

chiara operazione di propaganda

 che sfrutta il prestigio dell’Università, per attuare un 

maledestro tentativo di greenwashing

.


TELT non è un interlocutore tecnico neutro

: quando l’Università firma convenzioni di ricerca o formazione con questa, le presta la propria autorevolezza, porgendola al servizio dei suoi sporchi comodi. Chi lo scorso martedì ha contestato la legittimità di questo accordo sa che TELT non è un partner tecnico, è la parte che deve giustificare la propria opera, e l’Ateneo le sta dando man forte.


L’occupazione del Campus Einaudi e l’attuale occupazione di Palazzo Nuovo rappresentano, tra le varie rivendicazioni, il tentativo di portare all’interno degli spazi universitari l’ennesimo tassello del 

rapporto malato tra Università, imprese e fabbriche di morte,

 rendendolo esplicito e quindi contestabile.


Dall’altra parte, la risposta della 

Rettrice Prandi

 rimane la stessa: simula volontà di dialogo mentre dimostra di 

rimanere sorda alle richieste di studentesse e studenti

. Ma è possibile identificare il problema alla fonte. Oltre ai classici meccanismi di “rappresentanza”, quali strumenti vengono dati alla comunità accademica per aver voce in capitolo su temi cruciali come questi? Non vengono fatte campagne informative, non vengono chieste opinioni o pareri e al 

dissenso si risponde schierando celere e digos

.


Nulla di nuovo… come in Val di Susa non vengono considerate/i le/gli abitanti, allo stesso modo in Università non vengono contemplate le posizioni contrarie di studentesse e studenti. Quando poi, le contraddizioni fanno emergere dissenso e conflitto, entrano in gioco diversi meccanismi di 

delegittimazione della protesta

, dall’infantilizzazione alla criminalizzazione di chi dissente.


La posta in gioco è chiara: la 

Torino-Lione è un’opera inutile, costosa e distruttiva

, e l’Università non può prestare il proprio nome a chi la difende e la promuove. 


Il Movimento No Tav lo dice da anni: 

TELT non è un interlocutore ma un avversario

. E adesso lo dicono anche le studentesse e gli studenti in occupazione.

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: ‘Make Pax Silica deal public’
content:
Participants put their signatures signifying their opposition to the Pax Silica Initiative during the launching of the Network Opposed to Pax Silica (NO to Pax Silica) on August 31, 2026. By Dulce Amor Rodriguez/Bulatlat

A multisectoral group demanded that the draft Pax Silica agreement be made public as the Philippine government announced that there would be no signing of it during United States President Donald Trump’s visit for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit.

Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) said that the draft’s disclosure should include all provisions related to territorial control, legal jurisdiction, regulatory exemptions, taxation, and security arrangements, as well as the rights and privileges being sought by the Trump administration.

The group stressed that the Filipino people have the right to know. “We say no to secret negotiations or backroom deals involving Philippine territory, jurisdiction, and sovereign rights,” Bayan said in a statement.

Read: Why Pax Silica is bad for the Philippines

Before the confirmation of Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo that there would be no Pax Silica framework signing during the ASEAN Summit, it was reportedly being targeted during Trump’s visit this month although there was no official announcement on the matter.

Under the Pax Silica initiative, a 1,600-hectare industrial hub called Clark Advanced Manufacturing Park (CAMP) is planned to be constructed in New Clark City, Tarlac, being promoted as an economic security zone (ESZ) that would strengthen shared supply chains in semiconductors and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies.

The multisectoral group suspects that the recent development has something to do with the “greater concession” of the US to the Philippines.

US Undersecretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg earlier shared in a podcast the two phases of the plan. The first phase, he said, included the US State Department’s move of “taking into custody” the ESZ, while the second one was for long-term development.

The US plan of taking the hub into its custody, however, was denied, according to Joshua Bingcang, president and chief executive of the state-run Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA), treating the project as a “regular business development contract.”

Read: US, Malacañang urged: ‘Disclose the true nature of Pax Silica’

During a joint meeting of House committees on Economic Affairs and the Trade and Industry on November 11, Kabataan Party-list Rep. Renee Co raised Bayan’s suspicion, to which Rodolfo replied that they have yet to have a sit-down negotiation with the US, only exchanges of documents and ideas.

Bingcang said that they are now negotiating with the US for the commercial arrangement. On the concern regarding the nation’s sovereignty, he said that it has already been addressed, assuring that the ESZ shall be governed by two Philippine laws, namely the Investors’ Lease Act and the Bases Conversion and Development Act.

Aside from issues concerning national sovereignty, the Pax Silica initiative was opposed due to community displacement and possible environmental degradation and unequal economic benefits.

ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio called on the Philippine Congress to examine any framework or agreement that commits the nation’s territory and resources to the interest of foreign countries. (DAA)

author: Helmut Weiss
title: Die Migrations-Karawane auf dem Balkan: Niemand droht mit der Armee. Die Polizei ist schon da…
content:
Dossier


„

Fangen wir mit den Flüchtlingen an: An der EU-Außengrenze zwischen Bosnien-Herzegowina und Kroatien sitzen derzeit Hunderte Flüchtlinge fest, wie die deutsch-europäische Presseschau “Eurotopics” meldet. Die Polizei hindert sie daran, in die EU zu gelangen. In Kroatien ist eine Debatte über den Umgang mit den Migranten entbrannt. Ein Lokalpolitiker forderte, sie mit Stacheldraht und Maschinengewehren vom Grenzübertritt abzuhalten. In Kroatien ist das ein Riesen-Thema, in der EU nicht. Lieber befassen wir uns mit den Flüchtlingen, die von Mexiko in die USA ziehen wollen. Es ist ja auch einfacher, sich über US-Präsident Trump zu erregen, als über unsere eigenen Leute

…“ – aus dem

Beitrag „Auf dem Balkan brodelt es“ am 07. November 2018 bei Lost in Europe


, worin die sehr unterschiedliche „Popularität“ der Karawanen in Mexiko und auf dem Balkan deutlich gemacht wird. Siehe dazu weitere Beiträge aus den betroffenen Ländern:


Das ist euer GEAS 2026: Maskierte kroatische Polizisten prügeln an der kroatisch-bosnischen Grenze 53 Menschen zurück, fünf Schwerverletzte


Kopfverletzungen und Brüche: SOS Balkanroute berichtet von brutalen Pushbacks an Kroatiens Grenze


„… Bei einem kroatischen Polizeieinsatz an der bosnischen Grenze sind nach Angaben von SOS Balkanroute mehrere Migranten verletzt worden. „Fünf Menschen mussten mit Bein- und Armbrüchen sowie Kopfverletzungen von der Rettung abtransportiert werden. Zwölf weitere, darunter neun Verletzte, brachte SOS Balkanroute per Taxi ins Camp Lipa“, teilte die Hilfsorganisation am Freitag in einer Aussendung mit. Es sei „einer der brutalsten Fälle von Grenzgewalt“ der vergangenen Monate. Insgesamt sollen am Mittwoch 53 Menschen nach Bosnien-Herzegowina zurückgedrängt worden sein. „Rund 15 maskierte kroatische Polizisten sollen auf alles eingeschlagen haben, was sich bewegt“, so die österreichische Hilfsorganisation. Ein mobiles Team, das SOS Balkanroute gemeinsam mit dem Roten Kreuz betreibt, habe 40 Betroffene in sechs Gruppen angetroffen. Sie stammten aus Bangladesch, dem Sudan, Pakistan, Indien und Nepal. Unter ihnen seien drei Frauen und zwei Minderjährige gewesen. (…) „Das ist kein Einzelfall und kein Ausrutscher einzelner Beamter. Diese Gewalt an der EU-Außengrenze ist systematisch, sie passiert seit Jahren, und sie wird immer hemmungsloser“, betonte SOS-Balkanroute-Gründer Petar Rosandic. „Maskierte Polizisten prügeln auf Menschen ein, darunter Frauen und Minderjährige, und jagen sie im November ohne Schuhe über die Grenze. Wer so etwas tut, hat jedes Maß verloren.“ Das mobile Team von SOS Balkanroute und dem Roten Kreuz registriere tagtäglich Pushbacks und sehe dabei Spuren von Gewalt. „Das ist euer GEAS 2026“, kritisierte Rosandic mit Blick auf das heuer in Kraft getretene Gemeinsame Europäische Asylsystem. „Das GEAS ist tot – wir sehen jeden Tag, wie altes und neues Recht gebrochen wird. Wir dokumentieren, wir benennen, und wir machen es öffentlich. Jedes Mal“, forderte er eine unabhängige Untersuchung des Vorfalls vom Mittwoch und alle dokumentierten Pushbacks an der kroatisch-bosnischen Grenze, eine verlässliche medizinische Versorgung und sichere Transporte für alle Betroffenen sowie ein klares öffentliches Bekenntnis Österreichs und der EU gegen Gewalt an der EU-Außengrenze…“


Bericht des Newsteams vom 13. November 2026 im Standard online

 


Das ist euer GEAS 2026: Maskierte Polizisten, gebrochene Knochen und Blut an kroatischer Grenze (FOTOS + VIDEOS)


„53 Menschen an der kroatisch-bosnischen Grenze zurückgeprügelt, fünf Schwerverletzte. SOS Balkanroute: „Diese Gewalt ist System – wir lassen nicht zu, dass sie verschwiegen wird.“ (…) „Es kann nicht mehr so weitergehen, dass diese Gewalt verschwiegen wird – von den Behörden in Kroatien, von den Medien, von der EU und auch von der österreichischen Politik, die sogenannten Grenzschutz finanziert und bei den Folgen wegschaut“, sagt Rosandić. „Das ist euer GEAS 2026. Das GEAS ist tot – wir sehen jeden Tag, wie altes und neues Recht gebrochen wird. Wir dokumentieren, wir benennen, und wir machen es öffentlich. Jedes Mal.“ SOS Balkanroute fordert: – eine unabhängige Untersuchung des Vorfalls vom 11. November und aller dokumentierten Pushbacks an der kroatisch-bosnischen Grenze, – eine verlässliche medizinische Versorgung und sichere Transporte für alle Pushback-Betroffenen, – ein klares öffentliches Bekenntnis Österreichs und der EU gegen Gewalt an der EU-Außengrenze statt Schweigen.“ …

author: Main alba channel
title: Emma Goldman. Une femme extrêmement dangereuse. Vostfr
content:
Emma Goldman


Une femme extrêmement dangereuse


(Vostfr)


Emma Goldman


(27 juin 1869 – 14 mai 1940).


Une célèbre anarchiste d'origine lituanienne connue pour ses écrits et ses manifestes libertaires et féministes.


À 16 ans, elle émigre aux États-Unis. Elle rejoint le mouvement libertaire lors de la lutte contre l'exécution des 4 anarchistes martyrs de Chicago.


Elle est emprisonnée plusieurs fois pour ses prises de positions anticapitalistes, féministes et pacifistes lors de la 1ère guerre mondiale.


En 1919, qualifiée de "femme la plus dangereuse  d'Amérique" par le fondateur du FBI, J. Edgar Hoover, elle est expulsée des États-Unis et déportée en Russie.


Choquée par la répression meurtrière menée par les bolchéviques contre toute tentative de libre expression, elle finit par quitter le pays pour mener une campagne de  dénonciation de cette dérive autoritaire.


En 1936, pendant la guerre civile, elle collabore avec les libertaires espagnols dont elle sera la porte-parole à Londres.


Mai 1940, elle meurt  au Canada. Elle est enterrée au cimetière de Chicago, tout près des martyrs de Haymarket.


Titre original :


American Experience S16.E07.


"Emma Goldman. An exceedingly dangerous woman."


2004 - 90 minutes


Écrit et réalisé par Mel Bucklin

author: Bulatlat Contributors
title: Police violently disperse, arrest hundreds in Muntinlupa protest
content:
More than a hundred protesters were arrested today, November 15 after police dispersed the contingent of progressive groups in the Southern Tagalog region who will be joining the protest next week in time for US President Donald Trumps’a arrival in the country.

After a long stand off between the police and the protesters, the Lakbayan Southern Tagalog was dispersed by the Southern Police District at Sucat People’s Park in Muntinlupa City at past 2:00 p.m., leading to the arrest of roughly 300 individuals, including more than 10 student journalists and alternative media reporters.

The protesters were headed to the Kampuhan protest at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila to protest against the Pax Silica initiative and the arrival of U.S. President Donald Trump for the ASEAN Summit in Pasay; however they were halted in Sucat, Muntinlupa.

Witnesses reported that initial negotiations with the police were conducted to allow the demonstrators to proceed with the protest.

Shortly after, police officers reportedly issued a final warning, stating, “Pasensyahan po, pinagbigyan namin kayo pero ayaw niyo sumunod,” before moving in to break up the assembly.

Witnesses reported that the dispersal quickly escalated and turned violent as police officers began dragging away participants.

One demonstrator recounted attempting to intervene after seeing a fellow protester being dragged by police. Alongside a T.U. and the Vice President of M.C., the witness attempted to assist the protester, only to be arrested afterwards.

Despite repeatedly stating that they were willing to submit to a voluntary arrest, the protesters claimed they continued to be subjected to physical force. One protester recounted how after managing to stand up, they were allegedly pushed toward the nearby police station, dragged once more, and brought to the station entrance.

Human rights group Karapatan said, “The PNP has turned a public space meant for the exercise of people’s democratic rights into a site of violence and repression. Karapatan condemns these acts of brutality and demands accountability from the police officers and commanders responsible,”

“These disturbing scenes, recorded in full public view, expose the brutality of the police and the extent to which state forces are willing to go to suppress dissent,” said Cristina Palabay, Karapatan secretary general in a statement.

Palabay said the Marcos regime’s relentless crackdown on protesters exposes its desperation to appease the US government and serve its interests at the expense of the Filipino people’s fundamental rights.

Palabay said the arrested protesters must be immediately released. She added that while in police custody, they must be guaranteed access to their legal counsel, paralegals, relatives, and representatives of their respective organizations, as well as immediate medical attention.

“We demand that the PNP stop all forms of physical and psychological abuse against them,” Palabay said.

In a statement, the College Editors Guild of the Philippines (CEGP) confirmed that more than 10 campus and alternative media journalists were arrested, including: three from their group, nine from the UP Los Baños Perspective, three from the Southern Tagalog Exposure, and one member each from The Stape, Philippine Collegian, and CCC The Sentinel, alongside campus journalists from Parañaque and UP Baguio.

The CEGP vehemently condemned the mass arrests and over 24 hours of harassment and intimidation, describing the operations as a deliberate crackdown on press freedom and peaceful dissent stemming from Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ‘s “overkill” police deployment.

“Not only are those who participate in the protests being targeted, but publications that highlight the grassroot struggle of those who are affected by Pax Silica,” the CEGP stated.

Altermidya Network also condemned the arrest saying, “The government cannot claim to uphold democratic freedoms before the international community while police forces suppress public demonstrations and interfere with journalists documenting events on the ground.” (With reports from Anne Marxze Umil) (AMU,RVO)

title: Two Kurds arrested in Bokan
content:
According to information reported by Kolbernews, Iranian regime forces arrested two Kurdish citizens in the city of Bokan.


The individuals arrested were identified as Nasir Qorxçî and Şehab Qorxçî, both from the village of Reşan, in the Bokan area. No information has been obtained regarding the reasons for their arrests or their current whereabouts.

author: Unknown
title: Biçer: Kurdish cinema must build historical awareness in peace process
content:
Kurdish cinema in Turkey has faced censorship and repression throughout its history. Not only Kurdish cinema but also film and television projects dealing with Kurdistan have been forced to contend with censorship and pressure from successive governments.


Documentaries and films struggle to find venues for screenings, while cinemas refuse to show these productions. Most recently, the film Rojbash, which focuses on Teatra Jiyana Nû, has still not been released. Legal proceedings concerning the film are also ongoing. Another production unable to secure screening venues is a documentary about the Vartinis massacre.


Director Ömer Biçer, who documented the Vartinis massacre, spoke to ANF about the problems facing Kurdish cinema and the role of cinema in the struggle for peace.


‘I saw cinema as a responsibility’


Director Ömer Biçer, who began working in cinema in 2021, described how he became involved in filmmaking and his journey towards directing. Biçer said that he entered the world of cinema after meeting friends at Istasyon Akademi Mezopotamya Sinema.


Biçer said: “I was looking for an answer to the question, ‘Could I become a filmmaker?’ I believed that cinema was a collective art form and that we could become filmmakers by taking part in any aspect of it. However, looking at my earliest works, I found myself directing, which is one of the areas of cinema that carries the greatest responsibility in terms of production.


The reason was that, in 2021, Kurdistan and Turkey were experiencing difficult conditions of war, which affected every field of art. Making art was becoming increasingly difficult, particularly filmmaking. I saw this as a responsibility. It reminded me of something Ahmedê Xanî said when writing Mem û Zîn: ‘Hanî ji kemala bêkemalî / Meydana kemalê dît valî.’ In other words, Xanî saw a void in the field of artistic excellence. He wrote Mem û Zîn not because he considered himself exceptionally talented, but out of love for his people and a sense of national responsibility. I can say that I found myself in a similar situation and felt something similar.”


‘Kurdish society also guides its artists’


Biçer said that before making the Vartinis documentary, he had produced a short film addressing a public health problem that emerged during the resistance in Sur. 


Biçer continued: “Before Vartinis, I actually made a film called Sêhiya Gel in 2024. It dealt with a public health problem during the Sur resistance in 2015. During the post-production stage, after filming had been completed, this story and project came to me. It was actually a request from the people of Vartinis.


I think I felt ready for it, as though I had been preparing for years. A group of people came and said, ‘This is what happened to us, and this is how it ended. There was a massacre, followed by a second massacre through the legal system. We do not want this to be forgotten.’


At that point, regardless of whether someone is a filmmaker, whether new or experienced, any human being would try to become part of that story.


Anyone with a sense of moral responsibility would say, ‘Something like this has happened, I have been asked to take part, and I will accept that responsibility.’ That was the concern that motivated us to begin.


But both while making Vartinis and through the reactions we received afterwards, we were reminded of something: Kurdish society is genuinely dynamic and political. What I saw was that Kurdish society can also guide its artists. What was Kurdish cinema dealing with? What kind of narrative was it pursuing? When the issue of Vartinis emerged, we could see that everything else it had been dealing with suddenly lost much of its significance. That is how the process of telling the story of Vartinis began.”


‘There was also a public health crisis during the Sur resistance’


Biçer also discussed his short film Sêhiya Gel, which addresses events during the Sur resistance: “I was in Amed (Diyarbakır), about 100 metres from Diyarbakır Square, close to Sur. I was dealing with some paperwork at a notary's office when we learned that a woman had been killed by the police. The woman, Mızgın Kılıç, whose code name was Ruken Amed, was killed by police officers while trying to enter Sur to support the resistance fighters there.


That was when I felt that the war was continuing and that its psychological effects were affecting public health. How healthy were those who remained healthy? What was the ethical cost of …
